title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Voiding, Transfer to a New Owner and Expiration
content:
# Voiding, Transfer to a New Owner and Expiration

A coverage of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage is in one of three states: active, expired or voided. It moves from active to expired when it reaches its expiration date or expiration odometer, and from active to voided when the vehicle's title is branded or its odometer was found altered. The date it expired or was voided is recorded with it.

## Article 1 — Voiding

A coverage is voided when the vehicle's title brand is one of the coverage type's voiding title brands, or, where the coverage type's odometer setting is Yes, when the odometer is found altered or inoperative; a void is only made from active status. The title brand is read from the vehicle's record and the status from the coverage's record before the void is made.

## Article 2 — Transfer to a later owner

A coverage whose transferable setting is Yes passes to a later owner, with the later-owner term (the later-owner term months and miles for the make) where it ends earlier than the original term; a non-transferable coverage ends at the change of owner. On a transfer, the coverage is recorded under the new owner as a later-owner coverage, with the expiration date and odometer under the later-owner term where that term is shorter.

## Article 3 — Expiration

A coverage expires at the end of its expiration date or at the first repair order whose odometer is above a non-zero expiration odometer. Expiration, like a void, is a change from active status.

## Points of judgement

| Fact on the records | Result |
|---|---|
| active coverage; title brand on the coverage type's voiding list | voided |
| active coverage; odometer found altered or inoperative; odometer setting Yes | voided |
| coverage already expired | no void is made |
| transferable coverage; later-owner term ends earlier than the original term | passes to the new owner on the later-owner term |
| transferable coverage; later-owner term does not end earlier | passes to the new owner on the original term |
| non-transferable coverage; vehicle changes owner | ends at the change of owner |
| repair order odometer equal to a non-zero expiration odometer | not expired on that ground |
| repair order odometer one mile above a non-zero expiration odometer | expires at that repair order |
| expiration odometer of 0 | no expiry by odometer |

## Hypothetical illustration

A transferable coverage whose original term ends at a hypothetical month 48 and whose later-owner term ends at month 24 passes to a later owner and ends at month 24; had the later-owner term ended at month 48 as well, the original term would continue unchanged.
